Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.50

- Handle the exact retainer buyback prompt across modal instances after an approved NPC sale, with departure diagnostics.
- Ask before Auto list sells stacks over 50; choose a listing size and total quantity to sell, keep the stack whole, or stop.
- Add a remembered “don’t split and don’t ask again” choice, reversible in Settings.
